name: Bitrise MCP
description: Connects AI clients to Bitrise mobile CI/CD: troubleshoot failed builds from logs, trigger builds and pipelines, and manage apps, artifacts and workspaces. For mobile dev teams.

skills.name: Troubleshoot Failed Builds
skills.description: Fetches the build log, steps and test results of a Bitrise build so the assistant can explain why it failed and what to fix.

skills.name: Trigger Builds & Pipelines
skills.description: Triggers, aborts and rebuilds Bitrise builds and pipelines for an app, choosing the branch and pipeline to run.

skills.name: Manage bitrise.yml
skills.description: Reads, validates and updates an app's bitrise.yml configuration and searches Steps and their inputs to improve workflows.

skills.name: Manage Artifacts & Testers
skills.description: Lists and inspects build artifacts and manages installable artifacts, tester groups and testers for release distribution.

skills.name: Manage Workspace Members
skills.description: Invites members to a Bitrise workspace, adds them to groups and replaces group roles to handle project permissions.
